panels.description: Alex inserts the casino chip behind the bookcase; a concealed latch releases. Keep the physical mechanism dominant and leave upper wall space.
The hidden workshop contains paper plans, analog gauges, a folded dog chassis and a sealed three-arm Measure case. Keep the room tactile and leave upper space.
Alex fits a scratched ceramic lens into TJ's dog-shaped head; the second lens activates. Keep the head and hands dominant.
The dark metal band engraved ADRIAN rests beside the unfinished chassis. Alex's hand hovers near it; leave upper space for his line.
